value.rationale: Complete sharp rank-three logical classification of a classical two-parameter distributive lattice family, also the natural posets of divisors with at most two prime factors. Captures non-obvious cross-shape equivalences P(5,6)≡3 P(7,7) and identifies exact 30-point smallest global testing bound. This is a natural complete invariant and model-theoretic reduction, not an arbitrary finite slice, with clear bounded-rank applicability.
